SMS Link Generator

Create an sms: link that opens the messaging app with a recipient and pre-filled text — ideal for click-to-text buttons on mobile sites.

Test SMS link

On iPhone the link opens as sms:+1555...&body=... — both forms are handled automatically.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the recipient phone number and your message text.
  2. The encoded sms: link is generated live.
  3. Tap it to test on your phone, or copy it for your website.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do sms: links work?

sms: links open the phone's default SMS app with the number filled in and, where supported, your message text pre-typed.

Will the message text appear on all phones?

iOS and most Android messaging apps honor the body parameter. A few older apps may ignore the pre-filled text.

Can I text multiple recipients?

Use commas between numbers. Note that pre-filled bodies with multiple recipients behave inconsistently across devices.

Is this private?

Everything runs locally in your browser — nothing is sent or stored.
